eval_mesh_to_mesh: run mesh-to-mesh evaluation comparing a predicted mesh against a ground truth mesh and return accuracy, completeness, and F-score metrics
compute_pts_to_mesh_dist: compute the minimum distance from a set of 3D points to a mesh by processing faces in batches
point_to_closest_tri_dist: compute the minimum distance from points to triangle faces using barycentric coordinate projection
point_to_closest_vertex_dist: compute the minimum distance from points to the nearest vertex of a set of triangles
review_mesh_utils: review the mesh_utils module functions for point-to-mesh distance computation and mesh evaluation metrics
